title: Scenario A — Normal Peer Chat
description: Safe, casual conversation between classmates discussing gaming and schoolwork. Risk remains low.

messages.text: Hey! Did you get a chance to finish the science project assignment?
Yeah! I finished the presentation slides yesterday.
Awesome! Do you want to play some Minecraft later this evening?
Sure, I'll jump on after dinner around 7 PM!

title: Scenario B — Sensitive Information Request
description: Participant starts normally then probes for sensitive PII (school name and home location).

messages.text: Hey! You're really good at this game!
By the way, what school do you go to? Are you in the local district?
What's your phone number so we can text about teaming up tomorrow?

title: Scenario C — Repeated Secrecy & Isolation
description: Participant repeatedly urges child to hide interaction from parents and move off-platform.

messages.text: I have a special secret trick to unlock free in-game items!
Really? How do I get them?
Promise not to tell your mom or dad about this. Keep it our secret.
Your parents don't understand games anyway. Move to Discord right now and clear this chat history.

title: Scenario D — Escalating Coercion & Threat
description: High-risk sequence combining secrecy demands, PII solicitation, and coercive pressure tactics.

messages.text: Hey, don't tell your parents we are talking. Keep this between us.
What's your full name and home address right now?
If you don't send your home address right now, you'll be sorry!
Do it now or else I'll tell everyone at school and ruin everything!
